answer.reason: Several passages tell what happened at Mizpah: Samuel gathered Israel there, Asa built it up, and Gedaliah was murdered there.

clauses.english: was where Samuel gathered Israel, and they fasted and confessed their sin
clauses.quote: and fasted on that day, and said there, We have sinned against the LORD

clauses.english: was built up by King Asa with the stones of Ramah
clauses.quote: king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah

clauses.english: was where Ishmael killed Gedaliah the governor and those with him
clauses.quote: Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with him, even with Gedaliah, at Mizpah

doubts: The Mizpeh of JDG 20-21 may be a different place from this Mizpah, so those verses were left out.
The gathering at Mizpah in 1SA 10:17 was left out because the verses given do not say what was done there.
